上车后，王磊掏出一盒烟，递给吴姜一根，得知吴姜不抽后，他便又把烟盒收了起来。

王磊率先打破沉默，随意地问道：“吴先生，看你年龄不大，做什么工作的？”

“王队长，您直接叫我小吴或者吴姜就行，别这么客气。”吴姜笑了笑，如实回答，“我刚刚大学毕业，还没有正式找工作，现在暂时在我爸的店里帮忙，打打下手。”

王磊点了点头，若有所思地“嗯”了一声，随后话锋一转，直奔重点：“好，小吴，现在能说说，你是怎么知道朱大庆的失踪案的？”

吴姜顿了顿，没有直接回答，反而转头看向王磊，反问道：“王队长，您相信这个世界上，有人拥有阴阳眼，能看到普通人看不到的东西吗？”

王磊挑了挑眉，脸上没有露出丝毫惊讶的神情：“你见到朱大庆的鬼魂了？”

这次轮到吴姜懵逼了，什么情况，现在的警察，接受程度都这么高了吗？

王磊见他的样子，忍不住笑了起来：“小吴，你应该不止拥有阴阳眼吧，我知道有极少的人，确实能见到鬼，但是却不能和鬼魂沟通。”

吴姜回过神来，点了点头，如实说道：“确实是朱大庆亲口告诉我他埋在哪里的，也跟我说了他是怎么被害的。”吴姜将朱大庆的话，都跟王磊说了，接着说道：“但是，这些话你们肯定不能当做证据的。”

王磊却胸有成竹，语气坚定地说道：“只要找到了尸体，尸体会说话的。”

见王磊这么说了，吴姜也松了口气，转而聊起了别的，大多是王磊说起一些办案时遇到的奇闻异事。

吴姜听得津津有味，也算彻底开了眼。

王磊跟他说了好几起光怪陆离的案件，直到这时，吴姜才恍然大悟，怪不得王磊的接受程度这么高呢。

要是搁以前，有人跟他说这些离奇的事情，吴姜肯定会当成天方夜谭，打死他，他都不会相信。

闲谈之间，半个多小时的路程，不知不觉就过去了。

吴姜缓缓停车，将车开到一处工地的大门外。

这是一片安置房小区，不知道出了什么问题，烂尾好几年了，一直没人管。

吴姜都听说过，这里的村民，为了房子的事闹过不知道多少回了，但是没有一点卵用。

After getting in the car, Wang Lei took out a box of cigarettes and handed one to Wu Jiang. After learning that Wu Jiang didn't smoke, he put the box away again.

Wang Lei was the first to break the silence and asked casually: "Mr. Wu, looking at your age, what do you do?"

"Captain Wang, just call me Xiao Wu or Wu Jiang. Don't be so polite." Wu Jiang smiled and answered truthfully, "I just graduated from college and haven't officially looked for a job yet. Now I'm temporarily helping my dad in his shop."

Wang Lei nodded and said "hmm" thoughtfully, then changed the subject and went straight to the point: "Okay, Xiao Wu, can you tell me now, how did you know about Zhu Daqing's disappearance?"

Wu Jiang paused and did not answer directly. Instead, he turned to look at Wang Lei and asked: "Captain Wang, do you believe that there are people in this world who have yin and yang eyes and can see things that ordinary people can't?"

Wang Lei raised his eyebrows without showing any surprise on his face: "Have you seen Zhu Daqing's ghost?"

This time it was Wu Jiang's turn to be confused. What is the situation? Are the police's acceptance level so high now?

When Wang Lei saw his look, he couldn't help but laugh: "Xiao Wu, you should not only have Yin and Yang eyes. I know that there are very few people who can indeed see ghosts, but they cannot communicate with ghosts."

Wu Jiang came to his senses, nodded, and said truthfully: "It was indeed Zhu Daqing who told me where he was buried, and how he was killed." Wu Jiang told Wang Lei everything Zhu Daqing said, and then said, "But you can't use these words as evidence."

Wang Lei, however, was confident and said firmly: "As long as the body is found, the body will speak."

Seeing Wang Lei say this, Wu Jiang also breathed a sigh of relief and turned to talk about other things. Most of them were Wang Lei talking about some strange things he encountered while handling the case.

Wu Jiang listened with great interest, and his eyes were completely opened.

Wang Lei told him several bizarre cases. It was only then that Wu Jiang suddenly realized that no wonder Wang Lei had such a high level of acceptance.

If someone had told him these bizarre things before, Wu Jiang would have regarded them as fantasy and beat him to death. He would not have believed it.

While chatting, more than half an hour's journey passed by without even realizing it.

Wu Jiang parked the car slowly and drove outside the gate of a construction site.

This is a resettlement housing community. I don’t know what went wrong. It has been unfinished for several years and no one has taken care of it.

Wu Jiang has heard that the villagers here have had quarrels over the house issues countless times, but to no avail.
